song.title: Go beyond
song.lyrics:
[V1] . Am F G C I see your footprints lead across the sea . F Am G I hear your voice call come and follow me. . Am F G C You walked through death to set my spirit free . F Am G C and give me life, life abundantly. . F G C You took my burden, made me whole. . F G Am Planted joy within my soul. . F G Am Now your love has made me bold . G so I can live...
[C1] . F And go beyond! Beyond the . C Am G safety of the shore, I settled for. . F And rise above! Above the . C Am G crashing waves of doubt that drown you out. . F C I'm made for more! And I declare . Am G that I am yours, trough wildest storms. . F G Am You're the reason and the way to go beyond.
[V2] So here I am, Lord, let me be your light to guide the ones still wand'ring through the night. I want to learn to serve the way you served and show the world your love so undeserved. You joined our hearts and made us one, children of the risen son. By your spirit, lead us on, so all can live...
[C2] . F And go beyond! Beyond the . C Am G safety of the shore, I settled for. . F And rise above! Above the . C Am G crashing waves of doubt that drown you out. . F C I'm made for more! And I declare . Am G that I am yours, trough wildest storms. . F G Am You're the reason and the way to go beyond.
[B1] To go beyond... ahh...
